# DELETE /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/assets/{attachment_id}

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** token · **ID:** `ep-261`

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |

| index | path | integer | True |
| attachment_id | path | integer | True |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Attachment must belong to the same repo AND the specified issue | validation | attachment.RepoID != ctx.Repo.Repository.ID || attachment.IssueID != issue.ID |
| Write access to issue attachments requires being poster, repo admin, site admin, or having write permission on issues/pulls | authorization | ctx.Doer.ID == issue.PosterID || ctx.IsUserRepoAdmin() || ctx.IsUserSiteAdmin() || ctx.Repo.Permission.CanWriteIssuesOrPulls(issue.IsPull) |
| Deleting attachment removes both DB record and storage file | business_logic | remove=true parameter |

### Error Paths

- **Issue/attachment not found** → getIssueAttachmentSafeWrite → 404
- **No write permission** → canUserWriteIssueAttachment → 403
